summary: Rate found: $59, oceanfront 8-9 $64 for 2026; over $50 but Acadia NP 33 km. Confirmed 30 amp electric only, 40 sites (20 RV); season, phone/email booking added; cleared 40 ft. Lead: bayfront should be bayview, loop road between sites 8/9 and the shore.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD, bayfront -> bayview: the operator sells RV sites 8 and 9 as 'oceanfront', but its own map draws the loop road on the shore side of both, and its photo 'Site 9 View' shows gravel road, then lawn, then the Reach. Own loop road blocks on-water under the 2026-11-01 rule. No RV site is on the water side; the sites west of that road are tent sites T8, 10, 12 and the map shows site 10 as a tent triangle. Official 'View' photos at sites 8, 9, 7, 10 show open water across the road or through thin trees, and H10 and 5 a glimpse, so bayview is earned. Imagery: open ground from the loop to shore, ~100 m by eye. Not edited; your call.

GATE: $59 is the cheapest RV night on the operator's 2026 rules, over US$50. Tent sites $49 are not RV sites. Gateway: Acadia NP 33 km (gateways.py), so the exception holds; a camper's RV Life tip calls it 'about an hour away' by road. Good Sam not checked in this pass.

REVIEWS: Google 4.9 from 206; RV Life 5 stars, split over two listings (11 and 9 ratings), $$. Quotes, Google: 'Large electric only sites with gravel pads set in tall trees next to the ocean' (3 months ago); 'the roads would be too tight for a rig our size', relaying the owner on a large Class A (4 weeks ago). RV Life: 'We stayed in site 9 beautiful views and awesome sunset', motorhome, 7/2024, $54. Campers paid $47-55 in 2024-2025 per RV Life.
FIT: no length posted; large gravel pads on the map's own photos and motorhomes among the RV Life stays (site 9, H4). A 23-ft rig fits on that evidence. The cleared ~40 ft rested only on prose.
RV LIFE has a duplicate listing (249549 and 258449). Not long-stay in character: nightly rates lead, no seasonal rate posted. Reservations are by phone or email only, no engine.
PIN fine: inside the east-west RV loop. The operator prints 44°16'59.9" / 68°37'18.7" (near the office, ~170 m east).
